title: Phones and narrow windows — round 5, your record-deck notes

steps.path: The strip across the top of the Android app
steps.headline: The + New session button is gone. New session stays inside the session list, as today.
steps.changed: You wrote "i hate the + new session". The bar is now ☰ and Projects on the left, the name with its status lights in the middle, and only the terminal switch on the right.
steps.notice: The name has more room. Starting a session is two taps (name, then + New session), the same as today.
steps.risk: The bar is lopsided: two buttons left, one right. The name is centred between them, not on the screen.

steps.surface: Top bar in a narrow computer window
steps.path: The YouCoded window on a computer, dragged narrow
steps.headline: Narrow computer window: nothing overlaps any more. Each side takes only the room it needs; the name gets the rest.
steps.changed: Your note: "the terminal and close/minimize/maximize overlap as well". Before, both sides were forced to the same width, which together was wider than the window. Now the left keeps ☰ and Projects, the right keeps terminal and the window buttons, and the name fills the gap and shortens with "…" if it must.
steps.notice: On a Mac the window's three coloured buttons sit at the LEFT, before ☰. The same rule applies there: the left side grows, the right shrinks, nothing overlaps.
steps.risk: The practice app can't pretend to be a Mac, so the Mac version is described, not pictured.

steps.path: Tap the session name at the top of the Android app
steps.headline: Session list: Working / Inactive labels are back; rows show the model alone.
steps.changed: You wrote "dont like the status light changes", so each row keeps today's worded status. The model shows without "Claude Code ·" or "YouCoded Coder ·"; the small brand mark beside it still tells them apart, and hovering shows the full name.
steps.notice: Still edge to edge with the "Your sessions" heading. If you dislike those too, say so in the note.
steps.risk: Without the dot, long model names cut off sooner ("Qwen2.5 Coder:14b" fits; longer ones may not).

steps.path: Click the arrow beside the session names in a wide window
steps.headline: On a computer too, rows now show the model alone: "Sonnet", not "Claude Code · Sonnet".
steps.changed: You wrote "the reduction to just showing the model … should happen on desktop too". This is the one change on the branch that reaches a wide window.
steps.notice: Model names are readable instead of cut off. The brand mark still says which assistant runs it.
steps.risk: Someone who uses both Claude Code and YouCoded Coder with the same model tells them apart by the small mark only.

steps.path: The pills under the message box, on a phone browser connected to your computer
steps.headline: Pills are much shorter, and the computer icon is light like the others, with a green glow.
steps.changed: You wrote "it should be light like the others, maybe with a green glow behind the computer outline" and "making the chips vertically shorter/smaller. by a lot". Pills went from 32 to 20 pixels tall.
steps.notice: The bottom of the screen is shorter by 12 pixels. The pills no longer match the shortcut chips' height above the message box.
steps.risk: 20 px is below the finger size master now asks for on phones, so taps may miss more often.
